titulo.alumno: Choosing article and gender with common nouns

intro: In this lesson you will practice choosing the article and gender with common nouns.

texto: Note the article, gender and number; check that the adjective agrees with the noun.

frases.alumno: What word do we learn today?

frases.estudio: Ο φίλος μου μένει σε ένα μικρό σπίτι.
frases.alumno: My friend lives in a small house.

frases.estudio: Τα παιδιά έχουν δύο κόκκινα ποδήλατα.
frases.alumno: The children have two red bicycles.

frases.estudio: Δεν δουλεύω σήμερα. Πού είναι το λεωφορείο;
frases.alumno: I'm not working today. Where is the bus?

pregunta.texto: Listen to the sentence and recognize the relationship between the words.
